name: query_routing
description: Laya decision router schema for fast intent reflex routing of user questions

questions.question: Is the user asking about upcoming scheduled calendar meetings, future calls, or what is on their agenda today or tomorrow?
Is the user asking what happened, what was discussed, what decisions were made, or what someone said in a past meeting?
Is the user asking about CRM entities, sales pipeline deals, customer accounts, or candidate stages?
Is the user asking about Kanban tasks, to-do items, creating a task, or tracking deliverables?
Is the user asking a general question requiring semantic vector retrieval across knowledge documents?
